claims.claim: The Communications Regulatory Agency issued a license to Starlink Director Rebecca Slick Hunter for service in Bosnia and Herzegovina.
claims.source_title: Starlink to launch satellite internet services in Bosnia and Herzegovina
claims.supporting_quote: SpaceX's Starlink service will launch in Bosnia and Herzegovina in the coming weeks following the official issuance of an internet provider licence by the Communications Regulatory Agency (RAK) to Starlink Director Rebecca Slick Hunter.

claims.claim: NASA is investing in Boeing’s Starliner to support astronaut flights into the 2030s while courting new vendors to replace Dragon.
claims.source_title: NASA invests in Boeing, woos new entrants to replace SpaceX’s Dragon
claims.supporting_quote: NASA is investing in Boeing’s long-delayed Starliner spacecraft to ferry astronauts to Low Earth Orbit into the 2030s while also wooing other vendors to create successors to the SpaceX Dragon capsule that’s dominated human spaceflight this decade.

claims.claim: Starship Flight 14 reached orbit for the first time and deployed 26 Starlink V3 satellites after one engine shut down during ascent.
claims.source_title: Starship Achieves First Orbit to Boost Pentagon Satellite Plans
claims.supporting_quote: SpaceX flew its Starship rocket to orbit for the first time on Monday, deploying 26 operational Starlink satellites on its 14th test flight.
